method: Fit a word-card successor table on certain adjacent paragraph words on the public practice training pages only. Each drawer is indexed by the final EVA-basic unit of the preceding word and contains observed successor words with their multiplicities. Start each eight-word line with a random successor card; thereafter draw a card from the drawer indexed by the preceding card's final unit. Seed 63218. Reject any draw that completes a four-word sequence from the public manuscript guard. No semantic content or target-class rule is used. The generator is a simple reduced test of the transition mechanism in R-042, which already reproduced this fact as part of a larger generator. The same fixed sample as the F-033 and F-034 companion attacks is used to test the contrast with across-line boundaries. The Markov state resets independently at each line break.
